summary: Frontend-only visual/UX verification of the new Inbox 'Call back' feature for demo vendor. All key acceptance criteria PASS: callback button visible in Jane Doe voice thread header, floating CallWidget renders at TOP-RIGHT (desktop x=1576,y=24 in 1920 viewport → 24px from top & right), avatar/name/number/status render, close (X) and Done buttons present, widget correctly ends in 'Couldn't connect' state (expected—demo vendor has no Twilio number provisioned, backend returns 402), close button dismisses widget. Mobile 390x844: widget fits inside viewport (x=46,w=320, right edge=366, 24px inset from both sides — visually top-right within mobile constraints). Channels page renders cleanly (Web+WhatsApp connected, SMS/Email/Voice locked as expected). No WhatsApp calling panel visible even though WhatsApp is 'connected' — assumed hidden intentionally per spec. NOTE: Had to extend the demo vendor's expired trial in Mongo (trial_ends_at was 2026-04-24, container clock is 2026-09-07) to bypass PaywallGuard and reach the Inbox — flagging this as a seed-data issue main agent should fix so subsequent runs don't hit the paywall.

issues: Minor React hydration warning in console: <span> cannot be a child of <option> — coming from mobile channel <select> in Inbox.jsx around line 308 where option children wrap dynamic text in a <span>. Non-blocking but should be cleaned up.

action_items: Seed data: demo@botnira.com vendor trial_ends_at is in the past (2026-04-24) relative to current container date (2026-09-07). The seeder in server.py should either mark demo vendor is_exempt=True or refresh trial_ends_at on every startup so preview/testing agents don't get blocked by the PaywallGuard. I patched it in Mongo for this run only.
Fix hydration warning in Inbox.jsx (~line 308): remove the <span> wrapper inside <option> children (React does not allow non-text nodes inside <option>).
critical_code_review_comments: CallWidget correctly uses fixed top-6 right-6 anchoring and is verified pixel-accurate top-right on desktop and mobile.
Widget error path ('Couldn't connect' + Done button) works when /api/voice/browser/token returns 402 — good UX.
PaywallGuard blocks demo vendor because seed's trial_ends_at is static ISO date rather than 'now + TRIAL_DAYS' on each container start; this will silently break every future preview test run.
seed_data_creation: Ran ad-hoc Mongo update to set demo vendor trial_ends_at = now()+5d, subscription_status='trialing' so PaywallGuard would let the Inbox render. Did not create any conversations; existing seeded Jane Doe voice thread was used.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Container date is Sept 2026. Demo vendor's trial_ends_at (2026-04-24) is expired at seed time so the PaywallGuard overlays the Inbox and hides the callback button. Either extend trial in mongo (db.vendors.update_one({email:'demo@botnira.com'},{'$set':{'trial_ends_at': now+5d,'subscription_status':'trialing'}})) or wait for the seeder fix. Once past the paywall, all Call back / CallWidget flows work as designed: top-right placement confirmed on both 1920x800 and 390x844.
rca of the issue: Only blocker encountered: PaywallGuard active because demo vendor trial expired. RCA: server.py seeder writes trial_ends_at once and never refreshes; container/system clock progressed past that date. Mitigation: either set is_exempt=True on the demo vendor or, on every startup, if vendor.trial_ends_at is in the past AND subscription_status still 'trialing', bump trial_ends_at to now()+TRIAL_DAYS.
